issue.title: Agent health watch fixes — publication wedge, leaked claims, stranded handoffs, bead open misuse
issue.description: Agent publication heals itself from conflicts on regenerable index pages and escalates once otherwise; finished monitors and failed staged handoffs stop leaking workspace claims and can be re-adopted; agents can no longer demote their own beads by running `sase bead open` to view them.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/agent_health_watch_fixes.md requests this work

issue.title: Core rebase-conflict policy for agent publication
issue.description: pub-policy: add a sase-core decision that says whether a publication rebase's conflicted paths are regenerable index pages that can take the upstream side, or must escalate, and expose it through the Python binding.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/agent_health_watch_fixes.md defines phase pub-policy as one work unit

issue.title: Self-healing and one-shot escalation in the publication job
issue.description: pub-heal: resolve index-page rebase conflicts in the agents clone automatically, otherwise park the project with one deduplicated notification and a doctor warning, and stop leaving unpushed commits behind.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/agent_health_watch_fixes.md defines phase pub-heal as one work unit

issue.title: Scope monitor retention evidence to the monitor's own workspace
issue.description: retain-scope: stop epic-launch monitors from probing the plan agent's former workspace during terminal retention, and fix the swallowed Workspace held notification.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/agent_health_watch_fixes.md defines phase retain-scope as one work unit

issue.title: Commit the Decision Sheet sibling on bead-work plan launches
issue.description: decisions-commit: make `sase bead work <plan>` commit the archived plan-decisions sheet together with the plan, as plan approval already does.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/agent_health_watch_fixes.md defines phase decisions-commit as one work unit

issue.title: Release leaked and dead claims in stale-running cleanup
issue.description: stale-claims: re-settle already-leaked epic-launch monitor claims with the corrected scope after publishing their stray decision sheets, and apply the held-claim TTL to dead gate claims stuck in a non-terminal state.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/agent_health_watch_fixes.md defines phase stale-claims as one work unit

issue.title: Keep reserved joined runs alive through staged adoption
issue.description: staged-join: stop the end-of-turn cleanup and starter watchdog from stopping tool runs that a staged monitor has reserved, and fall back to a fresh owned run when a joined run is gone at adoption.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/agent_health_watch_fixes.md defines phase staged-join as one work unit

issue.title: Make settled stages adoptable after a provider error, with muse parity
issue.description: staged-response: persist a staged response when the provider fails after a valid stage, let adopters fall back to the provider failure record, and give muse the staged-handoff wait guard and directive Claude and Codex already have.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/agent_health_watch_fixes.md defines phase staged-response as one work unit

issue.title: Make sase agent readopt work for held monitor handoffs
issue.description: staged-readopt: keep the staged monitor's owner lookup alive across held cleanup so explicit re-adoption can find the member, and make failed-adoption notices name the remedy that actually works.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/agent_health_watch_fixes.md defines phase staged-readopt as one work unit

issue.title: Stop agents from demoting beads with sase bead open
issue.description: open-guard: fix the worker prompts that tell agents to run `sase bead open` on their own bead, refuse agent reopen of non-closed beads with a `sase bead read` hint, and clarify help text.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/agent_health_watch_fixes.md defines phase open-guard as one work unit

issue.title: Record the real actor and skip no-op reopen events in sase-core
issue.description: open-actor: thread the mutating actor through the core reopen mutation instead of the bead creator, make reopening an already-open bead a no-op, and move the sase-core pin.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/agent_health_watch_fixes.md defines phase open-actor as one work unit
